packer.name: Fulfilment Assistant
packer.desc: Packs orders at the office every workday and books the courier at 16:00. Needs stock at Suite 2B.

support.name: Customer Support
support.desc: Answers customers and settles returns for you (replace if in stock, otherwise refund).

marketer.name: Marketing Associate
marketer.desc: Runs socials and promotions: more shoppers see every listing.

developer.name: Software Developer
developer.desc: Builds software. Each developer adds dev hours to your SaaS product every workday.

barista.name: Barista
barista.needs_text: needs a café (lease the corner unit in Old Town)
barista.desc: Runs the counter at your café, Mon–Sat 7:00–17:00: about 14 cups an hour.

driver.name: Van Driver
driver.needs_text: needs a van (buy one from Sam at Dockside Motors)
driver.desc: Takes your van out on one posted delivery run every workday from 9:00 and banks the pay. Drivers rarely plan the route as well as you can: expect a longer way round, and rush runs they can't reach in time.

traits.desc: Reliable: morale drops half as fast.
Friendly: lifts everyone's morale a little each week.
Ambitious: works harder, expects a raise within two months.
